name: Philippines
description: Philippines: 84 provinces (incl. Metro Manila), 1,642 cities and municipalities and 42,010 barangays from the official PSGC publication (30 June 2026). Codes are 10-digit PSGC codes. City of Isabela is listed under Basilan; barangays of Manila's sub-municipalities are listed under the City of Manila. Postal codes (1,490 for 1,474 cities/municipalities) from the GeoNames postal-code dump (CC BY 4.0), matched by place and province name.
source: Philippine Statistics Authority - Philippine Standard Geographic Code (PSGC), psgc.xlsx
